args.command: set -euo pipefail; rm -rf openchatx-linux-probe .npm-openchatx; mkdir -p .npm-openchatx; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/XiaoPuOuO/openchatx-mcp.git openchatx-linux-probe; cd openchatx-linux-probe; export npm_config_cache=/var/lib/zen-ops/work/.npm-openchatx; export npm_config_force=true; echo '===HEAD==='; git rev-parse --short HEAD; echo '===NPM_CI==='; /opt/node/bin/npm ci; echo '===CONFIG_ONLY==='; /opt/node/bin/npm run setup -- --config-only; sed -i 's#path = "/bin/zsh"#path = "/bin/bash"#' .openchatx/config.toml; sed -i 's#apply_patch = true#apply_patch = false#' .openchatx/config.toml; echo '===CONFIG==='; cat .openchatx/config.toml; echo '===BUILD==='; /opt/node/bin/npm run build; echo '===DIST==='; test -f dist/index.js && echo DIST_OK; echo '===SMOKE_START==='; set +e; timeout 12 /opt/node/bin/node dist/index.js > /tmp/openchatx-linux-smoke2.log 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; cat /tmp/openchatx-linux-smoke2.log; echo SMOKE_RC=$rc
